counts.description: A `Tensor` containing the total count of the data (one value).

mean_ss.description: A `Tensor` containing the mean sufficient statistics: the (possibly shifted) sum of the elements to average over.

variance_ss.description: A `Tensor` containing the variance sufficient statistics: the (possibly shifted) squared sum of the data to compute the variance over.

shift.description: A `Tensor` containing the value by which the data is shifted for numerical stability, or `None` if no shift was performed.
